name: vscode-claude-code-status-dot
description: 5-state status dots on every Claude Code tab (idle/running/done/pending/interrupted) + bottom 4-light aggregate + per-session token usage & $ cost + favorites sidebar (★) + completion/interruption notifications — minimal, reversible VSCode patch with auto-repatch after CC updates. QuickPick config panel follows VSCode UI language (zh/en/ja/de/es/fr/pt/ru).

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run companion:install && npm run companion:build && npm run companion:package && cp companion/cc-status-dot-companion-*.vsix dist/ && node hooks/assert-companion-vsix.mjs
scripts.test: node hooks/test-cc-status.js && node hooks/test-iife.mjs && node hooks/test-sbi-aggregation.mjs && node hooks/test-smoke-journey.mjs && node hooks/test-patcher-io.mjs && node hooks/test-version-sync.mjs && node hooks/test-contract-sync.mjs && node hooks/test-favorites.mjs && node hooks/test-smoke-favorites.mjs && node hooks/test-strip-roundtrip.mjs && node hooks/test-anchor-tiers.mjs && node hooks/test-keepalive.mjs && node hooks/test-standalone-patch.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check patch.ts hooks/**/*.js hooks/**/*.mjs companion/extension.ts companion/keepalive.ts companion/keepalive.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write patch.ts hooks/**/*.js hooks/**/*.mjs companion/extension.ts companion/keepalive.ts companion/keepalive.ts

author: wangdong
